column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
The place Kirino brought me to was the shopping mall.
As it was a day off, there were many people crowded together, like vegetables in a stew.
Well? What route are we going to take?
First, we'll go to the shop I should've seen with my friend and pick out a dress for work.
Yeah, yeah.
Without even waiting for a reply, she plunged headfirst into the shop.
...So, it would've been fine without me, right?
Ah... They got a new one!
Hmmm.  The design is good, but the color is kinda... 'Scuse me!  Is this the only color for it?
Hey, Kirino...
Ah, shut up for a second.
She forced me to come and all she says to me is to shut up?
Hey, what do you think of this?
Huh?
Ah, nevermind. Let me say this first. It's not your opinion I want, I just want a normal guy's opinion. Don't be mistaken.
I wasn't!
So? I'm still waiting for your thoughts.
It's fine, isn't it?
...What's with that vague reply?
Well, even if you ask me, all I can give is a vague answer.
Tsk... Ah! This is cute too!
Huh... Not even listening...?
I'm certain my male brothers of the world would understand my feelings right now.
This feeling of boredom and awkwardness is overwhelming.
I mean, it's strange that I'm at a store for girls.
And yet, if I were to leave this place, I would be forced to listen to her unreasonable abuse.
Phew... And... that's that with this store.
You didn't buy anything in the end. Is that okay?
Yeah, since I'm getting a feel for the overall image. After this, there's another round to go through it all. Then after that, I plan to go back and decide.
Another round going back...
It's for work, so of course!  This isn't something to raise a fuss over.
Well, before the next store, how about a little tea break?
Why are you deciding what to do? It's still too early!
Yeah, yeah...
I reluctantly followed after Kirino who walked ahead.
We've gone around more than 5 places already. Are there still more?!
This is absolutely necessary for working as a model.
Necessary for work, huh?  Don't tell me that in this recession, they have you taking care of your own clothes?
They wouldn't do that.
But, didn't you just say it was absolutely necessary for work?
Of course, during the photo shoot, it's the stylist that prepares the clothes.
Well, yeah.
But outside of photo shoots, it's not like those are my clothes.
It's okay to just wear them on those days, but if I wear them every day, during photo shoots I thought I could display them with better appeal.
If I have good sense there, I'll get noticed and I can connect with the next job.
Wow, models have it tough, too...
Of course! I'm seen every day! There's no excuse for half-hearted fashion.
Hmm...
Ah! Let's look at this one next!
As she spotted the next store, she went in without paying any more attention to me.
And then she started looking around the store as intensely as before.
She's even gotten used to talking with the sales staff.
Still, it's not that easy for her.
*sigh*...
Though I had only accompanied Kirino around for a little while, I had been freely used as a baggage handler.
There were enough bags to hold onto that I quickly became exhausted.
So, because there were so many, I was allowed to wait outside the store, which was an improvement.
Was she planning to buy this much if she came with her friend?
I sat on the bench and thought about this, and unexpectedly I realized...
...If it's her, she would.
Oh, isn't that Ayase?
Hey!  Ayase!
Ah... Eh?
I had casually called out without thinking, but as Ayase looked at me, she gave me a hesitant expression.
What's with that expression?
B-Because... those bags...
That's right.  I'm carrying bags for Kirino right now.
If she found out I'm on a shopping date with my little sister, it'll be awful!
Because Ayase has some kind of bizarre affection for Kirino...
If the situation were to be exposed, I could honestly say my life... is over.
Onii-san, don't tell me...
Oh, no!  This is for a female friend...
It's not possible for Onii-san to have such a friend!
The immediate rebuttal?!
A little sister fetish isn't so bad... no, even if you couldn't resist, it's inexcusable!  Don't tell me...
You've sunk to buying every thing related to women's fashion in sight... Imagining Kirino wearing them too!
Just how far are you going to go with your delusion?!
Onii-san... please continue like this.
Y-Yeah... Huh? Huh?! What do you mean?
If you drown yourself in this world of fantasy, the real Kirino will be safe.
So please continue to enjoy your shopping, okay?
Huh?! You're misunderstanding!
It's okay! As long as it's not hurting Kirino, I'll keep it a secret for you.
Well then, I have to get going. Enjoy your shopping!
Hey... Ayase! A-ya-se!
Without paying any more attention to my words, Ayase bowed her head and left.
Left alone after that sudden attack had me in a state of incredible shock.
What was that...
In the end, I avoided a nasty argument... right?
Hm? Why is your face so pale?
Kirino, who had just finished shopping, handed me some new bags.
And, she stared blankly with an unfathomable expression...
